verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair privacy axis for a cloud application platform, but the evidence pack never documents configurable retention periods, data deletion workflows, or deletion guarantees. Nearby evidence covers different capabilities: point-in-time recovery, daily disk snapshots, and an opt-out for CLI telemetry. These are backup or telemetry features, not user control over retention and deletion, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
